Zerion disclosed that a company employee was compromised in an AI-assisted social engineering campaign on 2026-04-14, leading to the theft of about $100,000 from internal hot wallets. Public reporting indicates that user funds and Zerion’s self-custodial wallet infrastructure were not affected. Public reporting and Zerion statements describe an employee-targeted social engineering and phishing campaign that exposed active sessions, credentials, and private keys for internal hot wallets. No smart contract vulnerability or wallet protocol flaw has been publicly identified.
